# streamline_topic (Resource)

Manages a Streamline topic.

Topics are the fundamental unit of organization in Streamline. Each topic is a category or feed name to which records are published.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "streamline_topic" "events" {
  name           = "events"
  partitions     = 6
  retention_ms   = 604800000 # 7 days
  cleanup_policy = "delete"
}

resource "streamline_topic" "user_state" {
  name              = "user-state"
  partitions        = 12
  cleanup_policy    = "compact"
  retention_ms      = -1  # Infinite retention for compacted topics
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the topic. Must be unique within the cluster.
- `partitions` (Number) The number of partitions for the topic. Can only be increased, not decreased.

### Optional

- `cleanup_policy` (String) Cleanup policy applied at creation. Configured changes require replacement; removing it preserves the create-time state because readback is unavailable.
- `config` (Map of String) Supported Streamline 0.3.0 topic configuration overrides applied at creation. Keys represented by dedicated attributes (cleanup.policy, retention.ms, retention.bytes, and segment.bytes) must be configured only through those attributes. Configured changes require replacement; removing configuration preserves its last known create-time state because readback is unavailable.
- `min_insync_replicas` (Number) Legacy minimum in-sync replicas setting. Streamline 0.3.0 ignores configured values; new configuration is rejected before creation.
- `replication_factor` (Number) The replication factor. Streamline 0.3.0 supports only 1.
- `retention_bytes` (Number) Retention size applied at creation, in bytes per partition. -1 means unlimited. Configured changes require replacement.
- `retention_ms` (Number) Retention time applied at creation, in milliseconds. -1 means infinite retention. Configured changes require replacement.
- `segment_bytes` (Number) Segment file size applied at creation, in bytes. Configured changes require replacement.
- `semantic_embed` (Boolean) Legacy semantic embedding setting. Streamline 0.3.0 ignores configured values; new configuration is rejected before creation.
- `semantic_field` (String) Legacy semantic field setting. Streamline 0.3.0 ignores configured values; new configuration is rejected before creation.
- `semantic_model` (String) Legacy semantic model setting. Streamline 0.3.0 ignores configured values; new configuration is rejected before creation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the topic (same as name).
